title: Dice roller with notation and history
when: The user wants to roll virtual dice, from a quick d6 to role playing notation like 2d6+3 or 4d6 keep highest 3, with a history.
prompt:
Goal: Unbiased rolls, correct notation parsing and a readable breakdown of every result.
Steps:
1. logic.mjs parse("2d6+3", "d20", "4d6kh3") into { count, sides, keep, modifier } or an error text; limits 1 to 100 dice, 2 to 1000 sides.
2. roll(spec, randomInt) with randomInt from crypto.getRandomValues and rejection sampling; returns { rolls, kept, total }.
3. Quick buttons d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, d100 and a form with a labeled notation input and a Roll submit.
4. Show each die and the total; dropped dice crossed out and marked "dropped"; total in aria-live.
5. Roll keyframe animation of 400 ms, skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.
6. Last 20 rolls with time in localStorage guarded; Clear.
7. test.mjs: valid and invalid notation, keep highest, totals with a fake random, even spread over 6,000 rolls.
Quality bar:
- Error explains the notation.
- Totals are big and clear.
- History is easy to scan.
Pitfalls:
- Math.random modulo bias.
- Accepting 99999d99999.
- Hiding which dice were dropped.
Verify:
- [ ] Form labeled with submit.
- [ ] Total live.
- [ ] Parser tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (parse and roll), test.mjs.
